definitions.explanation: The act of winding something onto a spool, reel, or roll. Used for thread, fishing line, tape, film, cable, and similar materials.

definitions.gloss: a roll (of paper, film, etc.); wound material
definitions.explanation: Material that has been wound into a roll, or a product sold in roll form, such as paper towels or plastic wrap.

notes:
Compound noun from ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wind, to roll) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take). Commonly encountered in everyday life (fishing, household products) and in industrial/manufacturing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巻|ま}き{取|と}り{式|しき}: retractable type; reel-type
- {巻|ま}き{取|と}り⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: winding machine; winder
- {巻|ま}き{取|と}り⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: winding speed
- {巻|ま}き{取|と}り{紙|がみ}: roll paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to wind, to roll — the base verb
- リール: reel — the device that winds
- スプール: spool — another winding device (loanword)
